title: Zesty Mexican Chicken Empanadas
description: Citrusy, flaky empanadas filled with mildly spiced chicken, kaffir lime leaf, and lime, perfect for kids to enjoy a Mexican-inspired snack.

ingredients.name: fresh kaffir lime leaf, finely chopped

instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add shredded chicken, cumin, smoked paprika, chili powder, and stir to combine.
Cook the mixture for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until heated through.
Remove from heat and stir in fresh lime juice, kaffir lime leaf, and cilantro, then season with salt to taste.
Let the filling cool slightly, then place about 2 tablespoons of filling onto the center of each empanada dough circle.
Brush the edges of each dough circle with melted butter, fold in half to create a semi‑circle, and press edges together with a fork to seal.
Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C) and place the filled empanadas on a parchment‑lined baking sheet.
Bake for 15-18 minutes or until the dough is golden and flaky.
Let the empanadas cool for 5 minutes before serving.
